chunks: And Ḥarīz narrated from him, عليه السلام, that he said:
"Everything that grows in the Haram is forbidden for all people, except what you yourself caused to grow or planted."

key_terms.أَنْبَتَّهُ: what you caused to grow or cultivated
key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the sacred sanctuary area in which special legal protections apply
key_terms.حَرَامٌ: forbidden and not lawful to violate or take
key_terms.يَنْبُتُ: grows or springs up from the ground

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on plants that grow in the Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning vegetation within the Haram sanctuary. It states that naturally growing plants in the Haram are prohibited to people in general, while making an exception for what a person has personally planted or cultivated.
